user.title: Device Watch
user.description: Watches every physical device for going offline and for a low battery, and reports it through events and two summary sensors. Under Configure you choose which devices are not watched, critical or without battery alerts, and set the thresholds.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Device Watch is already set up.

init.title: Device Watch
init.description: Every device is watched unless it is chosen under Not watched. The device lists are the labels Device Watch | Unwatched, Critical and No Battery Alerts: saving here changes the labels, and a label given on a device's own page shows up here.

data_description.unwatched: Ignored completely: never reported offline or for its battery. It still counts as a parent, so the devices behind it are not reported when it goes away. Wins over the other two.
data_description.critical: Reported offline after the Critical delay, and the event says critical so the notification can be urgent.
data_description.no_battery: Watched for going offline, but its battery is not.

data_description.offline_minutes: How long every entity of a device has to be unavailable before it is reported.
data_description.critical_minutes: The same, for devices labelled Device Watch | Critical.
data_description.battery_low: A battery level below this counts as low.
data_description.battery_minutes: How long it has to stay low before it is reported.
data_description.battery_clear: A reported battery is cleared once its level is above this - a new battery, not a reading wobbling around the low mark.
data_description.group_minutes: Devices reported within this window of each other are sent as one notification.

error.clear_not_above_low: "Battery cleared above" has to be above "Battery low below".
